market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH spot is ~$2,330-$2,345 on May 4, 2026. A dip to $1,000 by Dec 31, 2026 would require a ~57% drawdown over ~8 months. Even severe historical bear-market legs have rarely produced this in such a window from a non-bubble base; current price is well off cycle highs already. Base rate of 50%+ drawdowns in any given 8-month period is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: A black-swan macro/crypto credit event could trigger a cascade, but no such catalyst is currently visible.
